description: Put a custom image behind the slides. The image is read from an absolute local path, downscaled and re-encoded server-side, so an agent cannot write an oversized payload. span "slide" fits one slide; span "strip" fits the whole strip (slide width x slide count) and slices it by slide, which is how one long backdrop flows continuously across the export. Without slide_index the image applies to every slide; with slide_index it becomes that slide's override. Pass clear:true to remove it. Tune opacity, scrim, fit, and scrimColor afterwards with set_style background.image; for a backdrop derived from the slide's own screenshot use set_style background.image.useScreenshotBlur instead of this tool — it costs no storage.

clear.description: Remove the background image instead of setting one

image_path.description: Absolute path to a PNG/JPEG/WebP image. Required unless clear:true.

slide_index.description: If set, apply to this slide only instead of every slide

span.description: "slide" (default) fits one slide; "strip" spreads one image across the whole strip

name: set_background_image
title: Set or clear the background image
